Esther 6:12 describes Haman hurrying home in shame after honoring Mordecai, and 2 Chronicles 26:20 depicts King Uzziah being hustled out of the temple after his leprous transgression. Spanish apresurados ('hurried') captures the urgency, while the Aramaic cognate confirms the late, imperial-period flavor of this vocabulary."
